frase: Wide canvases on which to draw my visions.
aviso: Poems are published in their original Spanish, as all literary texts on this site are.
glosas_texto: Glosas on other poets are a common practice among décima writers. Here I chose two towering peaks, José Martí and José Lezama Lima, to hold a kind of dialogue with their verses. This rhymed room holds only a small sample of a much larger body of work that is still waiting for its pages. In the meantime, here, as a gift, are some of the Glosas Martianas and the Glozama Rimas.
glosas_nota: A glosa takes a stanza by another poet and closes each of its own décimas with one of that stanza's lines, in order.
